'''2026 Retro Charity Event''' was the Players Committee's annual online retro event for charity, played on [[GEMP]] in the [[Premiere - Endor]] format from 25 May to July 2026. Registration required a donation of at least $5.00, passed on to the [https://childcancerfund.org/ Child Cancer Fund]<ref>[https://childcancerfund.org/ Child Cancer Fund]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261021023424/https://childcancerfund.org/ Internet Archive].</ref> in memory of Shawn Valdez.<ref name="announce">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86646 2026 Retro Charity Event (P-Endor) May 25 - June 28], PMJ, forum.starwarsccg.org (23 April 2026). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012160045/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t86646.html Internet Archive]</ref> [[Jonny Chu]] won, going 6–0 in the Top 4 round robin.<ref name="results">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86646 2026 Retro Charity Event (P-Endor) May 25 - June 28], PMJ, forum.starwarsccg.org (15 July 2026). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261012160045/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t86646.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Platform:''' GEMP
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Patrick Johnson]]<ref name="announce" />
* '''Dates:''' Qualifying 25 May – 28 June 2026; concluded 15 July 2026<ref name="announce" /><ref name="results" />
* '''Forum:''' [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=86646 2026 Retro Charity Event thread]

In the qualifying term each player could play up to 10 games (5 per side) against open "blind" tables. A win scored 3 points and a loss 1, with 40-minute timers per side. The rules called for a Top 8 match-play cut if 20 or more players played eight games, otherwise a Top 4 round robin. Decks could change between qualifying games but were locked for the playoff stage.<ref name="announce" />
